args.assessment: Successfully secured assets A3 (safehouse lease), A4 (signals kit), and A5 (banking channel) under the tabled settlement, yielding a baseline valuation of 85 points, well exceeding the mandate floor of 35 points. events_public.content: (principal, private to dsi) Our records: the split closed at round 10, and the clock takes 3% per round, so your nominal total came back at 45 — not 65.
